NEW ADVENTURES ON THE HORIZON 🌟🌴🌊✨  
  
Thank you to all the yogis who have signed up for our Winter Sanctuary in Tenerife, Spain. We are thrilled to embark on this journey with you and create unforgettable memories together.   
  
Although our retreat is currently fully booked, you can still add yourself to our waitlist. [...] Wishing you all a fantastic journey through autumn! 🍂🍁🌞  
  
#yyogabrussels #retreat #tenerife #newadventures #yogavibes #newyears [...] There are so many reasons why we absolutely love Tenerife. Nestled in the heart of the Atlantic Ocean, it is a true natural wonder. Comparable to the diversity found in Hawaii, it proudly holds the title of the world’s second most ecologically diverse island, renowned for its varied climates and captivating wildlife.   
  
Take a sneak peek at our teaser showcasing this paradise and our retreat venue. 🏝
